info.name: padam
info.note: dyutAditvAt dyudByo luNiH 1.3.91 ityanena luNlakAre vikalpena parasmEpadarUpARi api Bavanti .

examples: 'hfdayasyAgraM pradyotate' (Sa॰brA॰14.7.2.3) GotitumAraBate. praSabda AdikarmaRi prakarze vA.
'guhAvadyotino'pyasti kiM dIpasyArkatulyatA' (gItA 4.18 ityatra nIlakaRWoktiH). avaSabdo dyotanasya nyUnatAmAha.
'hiSabdena prasidDa hetumavadyotayate' (bf0 u0 SaNkaravacaH). avadyotayate=boDayati=smArayati. avena nArTaH.
'sa stanayati sa vi dyotate sa u aSmAnamasyati' (aTarva0 13.4.41). vidyotate viBAti.
'sa hi dyutA vidyutA veti sAma' (f0 10.99.2).  dyutA BAsA, gaBastinA.
'yanme akzyorAdidyota pArzRyoH prapadoSca yat. ApastatsarvaM nizkaran' (aTarva0 6.24.2). Adidyota duzyati vikftaM Bavati.
'triBirnetrEH kftoddyotaM triBiH sUryarivoditEH' (BA0 anu0 14.53). uddyotaH prakASaH.
'harzaraSmiBiruddyotaM tasyAntaH puramAbaBO' (rA0 1.15.19). uddyotata ityuddyotam BAsamAnaM BAsvaram.
'aBidyotizyate rAmo BavantamacirAdiha' (Bawwi0 8.89). aBidyotizyate tvadantike virAjizyate. aBiH sAmIpyamAha.
